prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one landscape 16:9 in-game FULL MAP SCREEN concept for Depths, a dark first-person medieval dungeon crawler for landscape phones and desktop. The owner wants a rough hand-drawn map made by the heroes, NOT a perfect grid. Visual: restrained low-resolution pixel-art game interface, muted charcoal, dirty brown parchment, desaturated sepia ink, tiny rusty red/amber accents. A broad flat sheet of worn coarse parchment fills most of the screen, frayed irregular edges, a few small nicks, faint folds, rubbed corners, sparse dirt/smudges concentrated at edges; centre stays quiet and readable. Dark simple backdrop. It is a practical expedition sheet, not an ornate fantasy treasure map. No photoreal paper or intricate painted microtexture. MAP: about 5 explored irregular chamber outlines linked by clearly continuous orthogonal narrow corridors, all lightly wobbling as if sketched with charcoal; broken/double-stroked edges and sparse exterior rock hatching. Different chamber shapes but legible room/corridor boundaries, connected junctions, no square-cell grid, no graph paper, no numbered tiles. Preserve clear right-angle turns and a reliable route. Explored area occupies left and centre, right quarter is mostly blank paper where exploration has not reached. One short unfinished corridor ends openly near blank territory to show unexplored continuation without showing the hidden destination. Clear small amber triangular party marker with dark outline inside central chamber, pointing toward a passage. Sparse drawn symbols: a small ladder for way up, a little bedroll for rest, a crossed bar for blocked roots, an open chest for a discovered chest. One restrained rust-red danger mark. Two short handwritten marginal notes only: 'roots' beside blocked route, 'way up' beside ladder. Title in readable simple game lettering at top left: 'CAVE - FLOOR 2'. A modest simple Close button top right. A short readable compact legend along bottom, symbols labelled 'You', 'Way up', 'Rest', 'Blocked'. Keep the main map large enough to read at a glance on a phone, generous spacing, avoid tiny text. Dark ink contrasts with medium-light weathered paper. Drawing should feel like survivors made it in lantern light while navigating, imperfect in the linework but useful and clear. No decorative compass rose, elaborate borders, wax seals, skull decoration, oceans, mountains, dotted treasure trails, ornate calligraphy, isometric rooms, 3D buildings, visible heroes, gore, or dense textures. This is an illustrative art-direction mockup, not an actual generated game floor.
